rules.reference_ink: green below the crop's midpoint (local background to full ink)
rules.reference_red: redness R - max(G, B) above the crop's midpoint (local background to full red)
rules.trace_ink: black-edition render on the crop's own background; green below the midpoint between that background and Charcoal
rules.trace_red: red-black render on the red crop's background; redness above the midpoint between that background and Pillar Red
rules.4x_reference: reference channel upsampled 4x (bilinear, 1.5 px Gaussian) and thresholded with the same midpoint
rules.edge_distance: boundary pixels of each 4x mask; distance transform to the other mask's boundary; reported in source px
